release: UI108 — review document tables and recover Toolbox reads
implemented: Supported label/value tables and labelled rows retain descriptions, instructions, tools, supervisor guidance and declaration wording for editable review.

Changed explicit table headers apply to their following segment; short explicit stage headings organize checks. Printed answer definitions produce empty fields rather than importing completed answers, names or signatures.

Needs source review gives conservative original-source advice for repeated headers, titles, summaries, instructions and footers. All mapped rows remain included until deliberately excluded; name-only items, Unknown quantities and legitimate Total/Instructions names remain supported.

Find header row searches and pages through extracted worksheet rows within existing extraction limits. Proven Excel coordinates and notices about pre-header data or alternative headers support deliberate mapping; different layouts are not silently combined.

Read-only inspection preserves approval; mapping/inclusion changes require another check. Relationship-only edits preserve source references and advice, while complete raw-table edits clear evidence that cannot be established. Pending/uncertain save retries retain their original request.
Toolbox Talks shows a recoverable waiting/retry state when another form interrupts its read. Retry uses the current workspace, retains unsent work and rejects late data from a previous route.
UI107 boxes/contents, exact incoming same-worksheet parents, root locations, full Notes, SN/PN identities, append preservation and inventory verification remain covered by separate retained tests.
Ten static/offline Help pages explain table/source-row review and Toolbox retry. Changed importer and fieldwork assets and the shell cache use UI108 versions.
